text:
Elaine: quick sync — we need a concise decision for retention and export signing for the PM roadmap.

Sanjay: agree. propose 2 tracks: MVP retention (90d hot + 1y cold export) and Extended (3y/7y) via Dedicated/Private or hosted-metered exports.

Maria: retention toggles that change runtime behavior = Dedicated/Private only. Hosted should expose billed cold-export jobs.

Kevin: implementation sketch: tenant-prefixed objects + lifecycle rules. exports generate a manifest with sha256 and a signature field.

Kevin: example manifest snippet: `{"tenant":"t-432","start":"2024-01-01","end":"2024-03-31","objects":["e/2024-01-01/1.json"],"sha256":"...","signed_by":"platform|customer"}`

Ariane: legal need: signed manifest + timestamp + key-rotation log for chain-of-custody. If customer wants BYOK, manifest must be verifiable by their key.

Sanjay: BYOK options: customer-sign-before-upload (higher UX friction), platform-sign-and-wrap-with-customer-pubkey (better UX for Dedicated), or delegated short-lived signing tokens from customer KMS (operationally heavy).

Maria: Console must display who signed the manifest and include the signing cert chain for audits. Also show scheduled exports and estimated storage cost.

OpsOncall: ops risks — retention growth increases storage/index/backups. Require per-tenant retention quotas, alerts at 75/90/100% and scheduled export throttling.

Anya (UX): Console items: retention profile selector, export button + schedule, manifest download + verification instructions, cost estimate per tenant.

Elaine: acceptance criteria for MVP: 1) tenant query by id+range within SLA (95p <2s for <=30d); 2) downloadable signed manifest for exports; 3) Console shows retention state and cost estimate.

Sanjay: action items — cost model (Sanjay) by 2024-04-05; manifest signing spike (Kevin) by 2024-03-29; quota/alerts (Ops) by 2024-04-05; legal signoff (Ariane) by 2024-03-27; UX mocks (Anya) by 2024-03-31.

Kevin: spike will include platform-wrap POC and openssl verify/decrypt examples.

Elaine: plan Q2 beta for Dedicated/Private (MVP). Hosted extended retention pilot in Q3 (metered cold + export). OK to move to PM PR? :thumbsup:

All: :thumbsup:
